l.i: A prima sunt in α, η, ων, & ος.

main_text.l: A, ut πεποίηκα feci, ποίημα factum: πέπραγμαι egi, πρᾶγμα res, negotium:
ἐσπαρμαι feminavi, σπέρμα (resumpto futuri ε) semen: πέφαμμαι, Φάσμα
visio, verso μ in σ, non Φάμμα: εἶμαι
indutus sum, εἶμα, ἕς, vestis, unde ἱμάτιον.
memoria: ὁ & ἡ μνήμων, ονος, memor.
expuncto σ: ὁ & ἡ γνώμων, cujus o-

page.notes: Greek words are printed with accents; transcribed as closely as the scan allows. Some Greek letters in the first lines (e.g. "ἐαπαρμαι", "πέφαμμαι") are partly blurred and may contain errors. Upper right shows a stray mark on the heading.
